Definition: to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to narrow, form, nip, pinch, squeeze, wink, purse; 1a) (Qal) to pinch; 1b) (Pual) to be nipped or pinched off, be formed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
